title: Every live board converges, Intent's own first
objective: hv, 2026-11-10: "When done, we do an estate sweep and reach in thru each project's spinal cord and just do some brain surgery so that they are in line with this profile based approach." Every live board on this machine declares a profile, carries the canonical names and roles, reaches hv through one node and has a rendered roster, and the census that found the drift reads clean.
body:
## Director and judge

vc directs this package and judges each project's commit. There is no single builder: each board is converged by whoever the route below names, and vc claims nothing.

## The population

32 live boards on rhadamanth, measured on 2026-11-10: 18 under `~/Devel/prj`, 3 under `prj/Arca`, 9 in a client tree and 2 under `~/Devel/writing`. Backups, archives and vendored `deps/` copies are not boards. The census is re-run on the day, because the count is a reading and not a constant.

## The route, on hv's ruling of 2026-11-10

- **Intent's own board first.** `ac` was registered and `dc`'s role corrected from worker to devx by hand on 2026-11-10 (d09791705), on hv's word, so the apply reads both as unchanged. What is left is the hand form's retirement. The roster README is rendered with its present text carried inside the preserved block, and Intent prunes from it what the generated part now says. `.claude/restart.md` loses its "Your seat" section in the same commit, because the launcher appends that file to every launch and the section would repeat the generated brief in other words. And vc asks hv to retire directive 2, the brief written by hand, which leaves hv's board only on hv's word.
- **A project with no running session** is converged from vc's session: the dry run is read, `intent wb init --apply` is run, and one commit carries exactly what the verb printed.
- **A project whose vc or sc is running** is converged by that node. It is sent the exact step, runs it inside its own chain, and reports its sha, which vc reads. This is the rule since the Gtools release hold of 2026-09-25: only that node knows its project's holds.

## Before any write

- The brew-installed Intent on this machine carries WP-02 to WP-10.
- vc has measured what the released Intent before this thread does with a board at the new schema, and every machine that reads a project's board runs an Intent that can read it before that project is converged.
- vc's census table is in front of hv: for each board the profiles it will declare, every correction, registration and retirement, and every live message addressed to hv from a node that does not mediate. hv says which one-node boards are solo (Riffle and Prodinfra are the two candidates) and says go.
- Each board's own remits are read from its roster README into that table, and the sweep sets them with `intent wb remit` in the same step as the apply, so no first render states a default over a project's own words.
- On each board, the mediator has surfaced the live messages addressed to hv and cleared them, so the apply is not refused (AC-05.6).

## Held for a word

- **Pipeliner's `sc`.** hv, 2026-11-10: "I think that was a mistake and probably needs to be revoked and just back to a normal VC/CC/IC/DC/AC mix." It reverses rulings 9 and 10 of the writing-estate plan of 2026-11-05, so it is confirmed with hv and put to Pipeliner's own nodes before any write. Until then Pipeliner converges with `sc` as it stands.
- **The supervisor layers.** The three hubs that carry `sc` declare `supervisor`, Pipeliner among them until the word above, and the seven boards that carry `sv` declare `supervised`.

## What the sweep never does

It installs Intent nowhere and makes a board in no project that has none (hv, 2026-09-23). It pushes nothing. It writes nothing in a project but what `intent wb init --apply` printed.

## Molt

Molt's guide `docs/guides/sleeve-agents.md` and its roster README record the project suffixes hv named on 2026-10-21. They come to cite Intent's terms and record the suffixes nowhere, by molt-vc's hand.

## Done

The census re-run reads: every board declares a profile; no seat's role is its moniker and no seat's name is a session name; every board has hv and a mediator; and no hv inbox view exists outside a mediator's pair. A board hv exempts is named with hv's words.

## Depends on

WP-02 to WP-10 in a brew-installed release.
